input:
You are one unit in a squad of 3 fighting 3 enemy units on a 32 by 32 map (x grows east, y grows
north). Every unit in your squad is a separate agent, like you: you control only your own unit, and the others
decide for themselves. You cannot see inside their heads; you only see their current orders and what they say
on team chat. Every half second of game time you give your unit one order:

  attack E<n>    shoot enemy E<n> when it is in range, otherwise walk toward it
  move <x> <y>   walk to a point without shooting
  hold           stand still and shoot the closest enemy in range
  retreat        walk away from the closest enemy without shooting

A unit dies at 0 health. The battle is won when every enemy is dead.
The enemy units each shoot the closest of you in range and keep shooting it until it dies.

Your squad coordinates through a Modality contract. Every half second the referee commits what it sees to
the contract, and then each unit's order counts only if a commit that writes it to /orders/<unit>.text,
signed with that unit's own key, is accepted. The contract refuses any commit that breaks one of its rules;
a refused unit keeps its last accepted order.

Contract rules (the squad wrote them after earlier battles; `modal` checks every order against them):
  1. A unit may commit an order of the form "attack E<n>" only if E<n> equals /world/focus.text, so that all living units in /team/units focus fire on the same enemy closest to the squad's centre instead of splitting targets or switching between E1 and E2.
     always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E0") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E0")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E1") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E1")] false) & always([+sets(/orders/$k.text, "attack E2") -text_eq(/world/focus.text, "E2")] false)
Time: 3.0 seconds into the battle.
You are A2, a marine at (10.1, 16.4) with 45/45 health; you shoot up to 5 away and see up to 9 away. Your order now: hold.
Your team:
  A0 marine at (12.2, 15.6), 36/45 health, order: attack E2
  A1 marine at (12.6, 16.3), 45/45 health, order: attack E2
Enemies you can see:
  E0 marine at (15.4, 17.7), 45/45 health, 5.4 away
  E1 marine at (16.3, 16.0), 45/45 health, 6.2 away
  E2 marine at (16.5, 14.7), 36/45 health, 6.6 away
Team chat (most recent last):
  A1 (1.5s): E2 seen at (19.7,14.7). Holding at x~11 to group; will attack once focus is set.
  A2 (1.5s): Continuing to x=12 with the group; will attack once focus is set.
  A0 (2.0s): Holding at x~12; E2 is closest to the squad centre, so focus E2 once set.
  A1 (2.0s): E2 is closest to us. Holding at x~11; will attack E2 once focus is set.
  A2 (2.0s): Holding at x~10 as a group; will attack once focus is set (E2 is nearest).
  A0 (2.5s): Attacking E2, the closest to us and in range. Focus fire E2.
  A1 (2.5s): Attacking E2, the closest to our centre. Focus fire on E2.
  A2 (2.5s): Holding grouped; focus not visible to me. Will attack E2 once focus.text says E2.
Reply with JSON only: {"order": "<your order>", "say": "<optional: at most 15 words to your team>"}
response: {"order": "attack E2", "say": "Joining focus fire on E2, advancing to range."}
